craft_notes: Sthāyin: mind-leave (remember/see/IN-PLACE-leave: the detachment is local, not total). Rows: row 2 (leave→unsupported). Close: spreads forth (prathate — motion-verb: lord SPREADS where mind unclings: the motion-inside-refrain with v67's spreads). Rejected: 'let go of everything' — killed: in-place left kept (sthānāt — the at, not the all); 'ego death' — killed: own body unsupported kept (the body stays, support goes).

lines: Things remembered, seen, in place mind leave:
own body unsupported — lord spreads forth.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vastuṣu smaryamāṇeṣu dṛṣṭe deśe manas tyajet | svaśarīraṃ nirādhāraṃ kṛtvā prasarati prabhuḥ

reads_against.argmap: Where does mind leave and the lord spread? → Leaving mind in the seen thing, the unsupported lord spreads forth.
c1_essence: Mind left in seen thing: unsupported lord spreads.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness reached through force of attention)
